title: Week 14 — Study Space Challenge practice
status: Draft practice questions; teacher review required
instructions: Public self-assessment based on this week's lesson; not a confidential FiiCode examination.

questions.prompt: Which k scores 41/45 on the supplied validation split?
questions.explanation: With the fixed settings k=1 and k=7 tie at 41/45.

questions.prompt: The top validation scores tie at k=1 and k=7. Which k does the documented rule select?
questions.explanation: Choose the smaller k when correct counts tie.

questions.prompt: 41 correct of 45 examples corresponds to approximately:
Which cells count a correct prediction?
questions.explanation: True class and predicted class agree only on the diagonal.

questions.prompt: With 13 correctly predicted good examples out of 15 actual good examples, recall(good) is:
questions.explanation: Recall is true positives divided by all actual positives for that class.

questions.prompt: What should NOT influence k before the final evaluation?
questions.explanation: Final-test scores must remain outside parameter selection.

questions.prompt: In the Week 14 experiment, removing the Wi-Fi weight changes validation score from:
questions.explanation: The reference ablation reduces correct predictions by two.

questions.prompt: Select ALL elements to keep fixed when comparing k values.
options: Predictions manually corrected using real labels
questions.explanation: A controlled comparison changes k rather than multiple factors.

questions.prompt: Which conclusion is supported by the Wi-Fi ablation?
options: Wi-Fi always matters in real schools
On this validation split the chosen weighted model gets two more right
The final test is automatically improved
Wi-Fi caused the label to be correct
questions.explanation: Ablation supports a narrow observation, not universal generalisation.

options: Keep trying weights on final test until score is highest
Report only a headline percent without denominator
questions.explanation: Document limits and preserve an untouched final evaluation.
